response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT c.zoneref, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS conservation_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY c.zoneref, s.insurstat), ranked AS (SELECT zoneref, insurstat, conservation_count, conservation_count::numeric / SUM(conservation_count) OVER () AS fraction, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY conservation_count DESC) AS place FROM grouped) SELECT zoneref, insurstat, conservation_count, fraction FROM ranked WHERE place <= 10 ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST, zoneref, insurstat NULLS LAST;
